# The far bank: an earth slab x -9..9, world z -3..-7.5, top 0.4 m, its front face sloping into the
# water, the top jittered a little. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Earth --base-color 0.1922 0.0196 0.1176 --no-slot
material new Grass --base-color 0.2745 0.0549 0.1686 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Bank --size 1 --x-subdivisions 12 --y-subdivisions 3 --location 0 5.25 0.4
scale 18 4.5 1
apply --scale
material assign Grass
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 2
mode object
add mesh grid --name Slope --size 1 --x-subdivisions 12 --y-subdivisions 1 --location 0 3.0 0.2
scale 18 0.6 1
apply --scale
set rotation -55 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Earth
select all
shade flat
export bank.glb
